title: 魚と昆虫の図鑑風イラスト
lead: メダカ・サケ・クワガタ・バッタなど、魚と昆虫を図鑑風のタッチで描いた素材12点です。理科の資料や自由研究、解説スライドに使えます。
subject_en: Realistic natural-history illustration style, each ONE animal full body, side view, centred, accurate proportions and natural colours, soft shading. Outlines are closed and darker than the fill; light parts (snow, paper, white fur, plates) are warm cream (#FFF6E0) or tinted, never pure white. No letters, no text, no logos.
items: a Japanese rice fish medaka swimming
a silver salmon with a slightly hooked jaw
a stag beetle with large mandibles
a green grasshopper on all six legs
a cicada with clear veined wings
a red and white koi carp
a praying mantis with raised forelegs
a sweetfish ayu with yellow spot behind the gill
a field cricket with long antennae
a bubble-eyed goldfish with flowing fins
a firefly beetle with a glowing tail
